description: Quantizer that snaps voltages to a scale loaded from a Scala .scl file, with twelve independent inputs

params.text: Passes the input through to the output without quantizing it

inputs.text: The voltage to be quantized; a polyphonic cable here quantizes up to sixteen voices at once
A voltage moving the octave the output is shifted by
A further voltage to be quantized to the same scale
A voltage moving the root of the scale, 0V to 10V covering C3 to C5

outputs.text: The quantized voltage of the further input on that row

notes: the scale is chosen from the menu, which lists the .scl files alphabetically as the file name followed by the comment written inside it
a newly imported .scl file becomes the chosen scale at once
the root frequency of the scale is typed into the field in hertz or as a note name such as C3, and starts at C4, 261.626Hz
the plugin supplies a library of 36 Scala files, so a scale can be chosen without importing one
menu: Reset Root to C4 — puts the root of the scale back to C4
Add New SCL File To The Library... — copies a Scala .scl file into the library the menu lists
